note: Week-ahead plan of simulation ideas for TikTok @studycrest, in making order. Planned by Max and Claude on 14 Nov 2026. Each 'point' is the angle only: every figure and fact must be worked out and verified when the video is made (generator/README.md, Simulation videos, step 2); if the point does not survive checking, tell the true version or skip the idea.

ideas.title: What if the Sun vanished right now?
ideas.setting: A city park at midday
ideas.hook: What if the Sun vanished right now?
ideas.the surprising true point: Nothing changes for about 8 minutes: its light and its gravity both take that long to reach us

ideas.title: Titanic, minute by minute
ideas.setting: The deck and a cutaway of the hull, North Atlantic, 1912
ideas.hook: Titanic, minute by minute
ideas.the surprising true point: The iceberg did not rip one huge hole; narrow openings along the hull flooded too many compartments to stay afloat

ideas.title: What if the Earth stopped spinning for one second?
ideas.setting: A busy city street near the equator
ideas.hook: What if the Earth stopped spinning for one second?
ideas.the surprising true point: The ground stops but you do not: everything loose keeps moving east at the speed the surface was turning

ideas.title: What if you stepped into space without a suit?
ideas.setting: Outside a space station
ideas.hook: What if you stepped into space without a suit?
ideas.the surprising true point: You do not explode or freeze solid; you have seconds of consciousness, and the real danger is the air leaving your lungs and blood

ideas.title: Hindenburg, second by second
ideas.setting: The airship coming in to land, New Jersey, 1937
ideas.hook: Hindenburg, second by second
ideas.the surprising true point: The whole airship burned in well under a minute, and most people on board survived

ideas.title: What if you fell through a tunnel to the other side of the Earth?
ideas.setting: A shaft through the planet, with the Earth cutaway
ideas.hook: What if you fell through a tunnel to the other side of the Earth?
ideas.the surprising true point: You are weightless the whole way, fastest at the centre, and you arrive in about 40 minutes

ideas.title: What if you could see radiation?
ideas.setting: An ordinary kitchen and street
ideas.hook: What if you could see radiation?
ideas.the surprising true point: Everything glows a little: bananas, granite benchtops, and your own body

ideas.title: Apollo 13, second by second
ideas.setting: The spacecraft, 300,000 km from Earth, 1970
ideas.hook: Apollo 13, second by second
ideas.the surprising true point: One oxygen tank failed, and the crew survived by using the lunar lander as a lifeboat

ideas.title: What if a teaspoon of neutron star appeared on your desk?
ideas.setting: A student's desk, then the town
ideas.hook: What if a teaspoon of neutron star appeared on your desk?
ideas.the surprising true point: It would not sit there: without the star's gravity squeezing it, it would blow apart

ideas.title: What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
ideas.setting: A fishing harbour at night
ideas.hook: What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
ideas.the surprising true point: Tides do not stop, they shrink, because the Sun raises tides too

ideas.title: Krakatoa, hour by hour
ideas.setting: The island and the Sunda Strait, 1883
ideas.hook: Krakatoa, hour by hour
ideas.the surprising true point: The loudest sound in recorded history: its pressure wave went around the planet more than once

ideas.title: What if you removed all the empty space from your atoms?
ideas.setting: Inside a hand, zooming down to atoms
ideas.hook: What if you removed all the empty space from your atoms?
ideas.the surprising true point: You would be smaller than a speck of dust and weigh exactly the same; you never truly touch anything

ideas.title: What if you dropped a coin from the top of a skyscraper?
ideas.setting: The city skyline and the street below
ideas.hook: What if you dropped a coin from the top of a skyscraper?
ideas.the surprising true point: Air resistance caps its speed; it stings but it is not a bullet

ideas.title: The first nuclear chain reaction, minute by minute
ideas.setting: Chicago Pile-1 under the stadium stands, 1942
ideas.hook: The first nuclear chain reaction, minute by minute
ideas.the surprising true point: A pile of graphite and uranium, controlled by pulling one rod out by hand

ideas.title: What if all the oxygen vanished for 5 seconds?
ideas.setting: A city street and a beach
ideas.hook: What if all the oxygen vanished for 5 seconds?
ideas.the surprising true point: The viral version is mostly wrong; what really changes is pressure, fire and engines, not buildings turning to dust

ideas.title: What if all the ice on Earth melted?
ideas.setting: A coastal city, sped up over centuries
ideas.hook: What if all the ice on Earth melted?
ideas.the surprising true point: Sea level rises tens of metres, slowly, and the map of every coast is redrawn

ideas.title: Tunguska, second by second
ideas.setting: Siberian forest, 1908
ideas.hook: Tunguska, second by second
ideas.the surprising true point: There is no crater: the object exploded in the air and flattened a forest the size of a city

ideas.title: What if the Earth were crushed into a black hole?
ideas.setting: Earth from space, then a hand holding a marble
ideas.hook: What if the Earth were crushed into a black hole?
ideas.the surprising true point: It would be about the size of a marble, and the Moon would keep orbiting as if nothing happened

ideas.title: What if the lift cable snapped?
ideas.setting: A lift shaft in a skyscraper
ideas.hook: What if the lift cable snapped?
ideas.the surprising true point: Lifts have several cables and automatic brakes on the rails; the film version almost never happens

ideas.title: Pompeii, hour by hour
ideas.setting: The town under Vesuvius, AD 79
ideas.hook: Pompeii, hour by hour
ideas.the surprising true point: It was not lava: fast, hot clouds of gas and ash did the damage, many hours after the eruption began
